# Maintaining a Sourdough Starter

Feed the starter once a day at room temperature: 50 grams of starter, 50
grams of water at 26C, and 50 grams of flour, half whole rye and half white.
It should double within six hours; if it takes longer, the kitchen is too
cold or the culture needs two or three feedings to wake up.

A starter kept in the fridge only needs feeding once a week, but bring it
out two days before baking and feed it twice daily to rebuild activity.
The smell tells you the state: yogurt-sour means healthy, nail polish means
it is starving and eating its own byproducts.

Discard all but the 50 grams at each feeding. Keeping more just dilutes
the yeast population and wastes flour without making the culture stronger.
